name: Liquid Paint V2
description: SuperTool · Effect by SuperTool (Don). Fluid: Florian Berger (flockaroo), 'single pass CFD', 2016, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 — https://www.shadertoy.com/view/MsGSRd

injectAmount.label: injectAmount
injectAmount.description: How strongly the live clip melts into the fluid (low = more abstract paint, high = closer to the footage)

saturation.label: saturation
saturation.description: Paint colour saturation lift (1 = plain flockaroo, higher = richer paint)

iridescence.label: iridescence
iridescence.description: Oil-slick sheen whose hue follows the fluid flow (0 = off / pure flockaroo)

videoMix.label: videoMix
videoMix.description: Blend the crisp clip back over the paint (0 = pure paint)
